title.romaji: Eve no Jikan: Are you enjoying the time of EVE?
title.native: イヴの時間 Are you enjoying the time of EVE ?

description:
The future, probably Japan. Robots have long been put into practical use, and androids have just come into use.

Influenced by the Robot Ethics Committee, it's become common sense for people to treat androids like household appliances. Their appearance - indistinguishable from humans except for the ring over each android's head - has led some people to empathize unnecessarily with androids. Known as "android-holics", such people have become a social problem.

Rikuo, a high school student, has been taught from childhood that androids are not to be viewed as humans, and has always used them as convenient tools. One day Rikuo discovers some strange data in the behavior records of his family's household android, Sammy.

Rikuo and his friend Masaki trace Sammy's movements, only to discover a mysterious café that features a house rule that "humans and robots are to be treated the same"...

(Source: Official Website - English)

node.description: Waitress at the Time of Eve café. Her waitress outfit suits her well. She acts cheerful and carefree, but also somehow gives off a mysterious vibe. The café is very important to her, and she's quite severe with customers who don't follow the café's house rule. She seems to be particular about the naming of items on the menu.     ~!It is revealed in the movie adaptation that Nagi is in fact human and the victim of the injury incident caused by the robotic ethics committee when she was five.    Source:wikipedia!~    (Source: Official Website - English)

House-roid in Rikuo's home. Handles housework. Run-of-the-mill female model. Sammy's behavior is grounded in pleasing humans, in accordance with the Three Laws of Robotics. Complex commands sometimes trigger an error response. Sammy is always expressionless and speaks in a business-like manner, but...    (Source: Official Website - English)

Regular customer at the Time of Eve café. Knit cap is her trademark. Her personality is very upbeat and lively. She simply loves to talk, and isn't great at holding her tongue long enough to listen to others. She expands her circle of friends by talking to anyone and everyone who visits the café. She loves all things cute, and is particularly fond of Chie.    (Source: Official Website - English)

He's rather big for an 8 year old. His occupation was to look over his family's child. As an old model robot his response and speech functions are outdated, causing him to constantly question others comments. He seems to have lost his memory of his family,  ~! so that his family wouldn't have to pay a fee, they illegally abandoned him when they got a newer model. In order to save their personal information they wiped his memory banks. The only memory of them he has is a picture of him that the child he looked after drew, in which he is given his name.!~

High school student utterly typical of this era, and the story's main character. Kind and affable, but has a rather dry attitude towards androids. He's bossy at home, but not so in the outside world. Has little interest in the Laws of Robotics, perhaps because he's so used to androids, but is well-versed when it comes to digital tools and programming. He's particular about the glasses that he wears.    (Source: Official Website - English)

Regular customer at Time of Eve. Very energetic little girl. Her age is not specified. She's always playing around in the café. She reaches out and grabs whatever catches her interest, and likes to tease other people. Recently her favorite activity has been pretending she's a cat. She loves shiny things and ice cream.    (Source: Official Website - English)
The household robot of the Masakazu family. Remains completely silent except in cases of emergency.

Rikuo's friend. At first glance he seems to be a bit of a delinquent, but in fact he's a merit scholarship student with aspirations for law school. He's studying the Laws of Robotics, and is quite knowledgeable about the legal aspects of robots, but for some reason doesn't have one at home. His personality is the opposite of Rikuo's, which enables them to have a good friendship. Everyone calls him Masaki, but it is revealed later on that his actual name is Masakazu.    (Source: Official Website - English)     ~!It is later shown that he does in fact own a robot at home and the issues that followed it.!~

Regular at the Time of Eve café. Has womanly sensuality. She and Koji are always together and make a somewhat unbalanced couple. At times she seems kind of ill at ease. Seems to be strongly possessive of Koji, and never lets go of his arm when they are together.    (Source: Official Website - English)    

~!Rina is a female-form android bodyguard who has been illegally modified to perform as a sex-bot. She was formerly owned by a VIP, who abandoned her during an assassination attempt. Her right leg was damaged while she was attempting to protect her master, and it malfunctions periodically, threatening to reveal her identity as an android. Since she's been illegally modified, she cannot be sent back for repair, and is technically on the run from the authorities. She won't seek help because her existence would embarrass her master. Rina and Koji each believe the other is human, and their relationship is dependent on this assumption.  (Source: wiki)!~

Regular customer at Time of Eve. Kind elderly man. It seems he is Chie's guardian, but is always thrown into a tizzy by Chie's antics. His words tend to be laden with significance, but he also does really sweet things like practicing cat gestures to catch Chie's attention.    (Source: Official Website - English)

Regular at the Time of Eve café. Quiet guy who seems honest and simple. He and Rina are always together, and make a somewhat unbalanced couple. At times he seems absentminded. A shutterbug, he seems to be particular about cameras and always carries one with him.    (Source: Official Website - English)

Regular customer at Time of Eve. Man who wears a suit, and looks forbidding. He's always sitting on the sofa in the café reading a book, and it seems he doesn't communicate much with other customers. His occasional utterances give a glimpse of his aloof personality.    (Source: Official Website - English)

Rikuo's older sister. College student. It seems she's popular on campus, but at home she's lackadaisical to the extreme. She treats androids entirely as "things", epitomizing the attitude of her contemporaries, and detests "android-holic" types. She sees hints of "android-holic" tendencies in Rikuo.    (Source: Official Website - English)
